steps.sql: SELECT "ordered_at" FROM "orders" WHERE "ordered_at" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rowid LIMIT 1

WITH __kumo_keys__ AS (
  SELECT key AS __kumo_batch__, CAST(json_extract(value, '$[0]') AS INTEGER) AS __kumo_id__, CAST(json_extract(value, '$[1]') AS TEXT) AS __kumo_end__, CAST(json_extract(value, '$[2]') AS TEXT) AS __kumo_start__
  FROM json_each(?)
)
SELECT tmp.__kumo_batch__ as __kumo_batch__, "quantity", "ordered_at"
FROM __kumo_keys__ tmp
JOIN "orders"
  ON "product_id" = tmp.__kumo_id__
 AND "ordered_at" <= tmp.__kumo_end__
 AND "ordered_at" > tmp.__kumo_start__
ORDER BY __kumo_batch__, "ordered_at", "order_id", "quantity"

WITH __kumo_keys__ AS (
  SELECT key AS __kumo_batch__, CAST(value AS INTEGER) AS __kumo_id__
  FROM json_each(?)
)
SELECT tmp.__kumo_batch__ as __kumo_batch__, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "products" WHERE "product_id" == tmp.__kumo_id__) as __kumo_matches__, "product_id", "category", "price"
FROM __kumo_keys__ tmp
JOIN "products" ent
  ON ent.rowid = (
    SELECT rowid
    FROM "products"
    WHERE "product_id" == tmp.__kumo_id__
    ORDER BY "category", "price", "product_id", rowid
    LIMIT 1
)

WITH __kumo_keys__ AS (
  SELECT key AS __kumo_batch__, CAST(json_extract(value, '$[0]') AS INTEGER) AS __kumo_id__, CAST(json_extract(value, '$[1]') AS TEXT) AS __kumo_time__
  FROM json_each(?)
)
SELECT tmp.__kumo_batch__ as __kumo_batch__, "order_id", "user_id", "product_id", "quantity", "ordered_at"
FROM __kumo_keys__ tmp
JOIN "orders" fact
ON fact.rowid IN (
  SELECT rowid
  FROM "orders"
  WHERE "product_id" = tmp.__kumo_id__
  AND "ordered_at" <= tmp.__kumo_time__
  ORDER BY "ordered_at" DESC, "order_id", "product_id", "quantity", "user_id"
  LIMIT 32
)
ORDER BY __kumo_batch__, "ordered_at" DESC, "order_id", "product_id", "quantity", "user_id"
